title: Old Family Photos, Fixed for FREE 📸✨

segments.say: This old photo was ruined. Watch.

segments.text: A free AI on GitHub rebuilds faces from *blurry photos.*
segments.say: A free AI on GitHub rebuilds faces from blurry old photos. The last one is unreal.

segments.text: How: it's called *CodeFormer.* Free online, no install.
segments.say: It's called CodeFormer. Search it on Hugging Face, upload your photo, and hit Enhance Image.

segments.text: And this: it *rebuilt a scribbled-out face.*
segments.say: And this. It rebuilt a face that was scribbled out.

segments.text: *Save this* for your family photo album.
segments.say: Save this for your family photo album.
